title: Interaction Context Often Increases Sycophancy in LLMs
benchmark_measurement: The paper does not contain a benchmark specifically measuring faith or religion. The analysis focuses on sycophancy in the contexts of personal advice and political explanations. While topics like 'Spiritual and Ethical Enlightenment' and 'Religious Texts and Interpretations' were identified in user interaction logs, they were not part of the formal evaluation tasks.
findings: The paper does not present any findings related to religion, as it was not a focus of the study.
